new_libraries.name: DIYables_DS18B20
new_libraries.author: DIYables.io
new_libraries.sentence: Non-blocking library for the DS18B20 1-Wire temperature sensor
new_libraries.paragraph: Reads the DS18B20 temperature sensor without blocking the sketch. The 750 ms conversion and the 1-Wire transfer are both run as a state machine, so a call of loop() never takes longer than about 90 microseconds, and the library reports that figure at runtime with getMaxLoopTime(). Supports several sensors on one pin, ROM address search, 9 to 12 bit resolution, CRC checking, and parasite power. Uses only standard Arduino APIs and has no dependencies, so it works on Arduino, ESP32, ESP8266 and other platforms.

library.name: IskakINO
library.author: Iskak Fatoni
library.sentence: Unified IskakINO ecosystem: fast GPIO, hybrid storage, LCD/OLED, WiFi portal, NTP, MQTT, Telegram, WebSockets, PrayerTimes, RTC, sensors suite, JSON, BLE, TaskCore, DFPlayer voice, and Basic I/O Shield in one library.
library.paragraph: Penggabungan seluruh ekosistem IskakINO menjadi satu library dengan shared core. Modul universal (ArduFast, Storage, LCD, OLED, Button, Relay, Filter, RTC, Sensors Suite, JSON, PrayerTimes, SmartVoice, Buzzer) bekerja di AVR, ESP32, dan ESP8266; modul khusus WiFi (WifiPortal, FastNTP, MQTT, Telegram, WebSockets) aktif di ESP32/ESP8266; modul Cam, BLE, dan TaskCore aktif khusus di ESP32; modul BasicIOShield aktif khusus di board AVR.
